verses.sloka: विशालान् कोसलान् रम्यान् यात्वा लक्ष्मण पूर्वजः ।अयोध्याभिमुखो धीमान् प्राञ्ञ्लिर्वाक्वमब्रवीत् ॥२-५०-१॥
verses.transliteration: viśālān kosalān ramyān yātvā lakṣmaṇa pūrvajaḥ ।ayodhyābhimukho dhīmān prāññlirvākvamabravīt ॥2-50-1॥

translations.english: Having crossed the vast, beautiful kingdom of Kosala, the sagacious elder brother of Lakshmana stood facing Ayodhya with folded palms and said:

verses.sloka: आपृच्छे त्वाम् पुरीश्रेष्ठे काकुत्स्थपरिपालिते ।दैवतानि च यानि त्वाम् पालयन्त्यावसन्ति च ॥२-५०-२॥
verses.transliteration: āpṛcche tvām purīśreṣṭhe kākutsthaparipālite ।daivatāni ca yāni tvām pālayantyāvasanti ca ॥2-50-2॥

translations.english: O Ayodhya, the best of cities ruled by those born in the Kakutstha race I take leave of you and of all those gods inhabiting and guarding you.

verses.sloka: निवृत्तवनवासस्त्वामनृणो जगतीपतेः ।पुनर्ध्रक्ष्यामि मात्रा च पित्रा च सह सम्गतः ॥२-५०-३॥
verses.transliteration: nivṛttavanavāsastvāmanṛṇo jagatīpateḥ ।punardhrakṣyāmi mātrā ca pitrā ca saha samgataḥ ॥2-50-3॥

translations.english: On completion of exile and my filial obligations to king Dasaratha, lord of the world, discharged, I shall, reunited with my parents, see you again.
translations.hindi: गाँवों के सिघानों पर खेती के लिए जुते हुए खेतों ओर अनेक प्रकार के पुष्पित बृतों से युक्त बना के देखने में श्रीरामचन्द्रादि ऐसे मग्न थे कि उन उत्तम घोड़ों की तेज चाल भी उनको धीमी चाल जैसी जान पड़ती थी

verses.sloka: ततो रुधिरताम्राक्षो भुजमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम् ।अश्रुपूर्णमुखो दीनोऽब्रवीज्जानपदम् जनम् ॥२-५०-४॥
verses.transliteration: tato rudhiratāmrākṣo bhujamudyamya dakṣiṇam ।aśrupūrṇamukho dīno'bravījjānapadam janam ॥2-50-4॥

translations.english: He looked miserable, his copperred eyes filled with tears. He raised his right hand and said to the villagers who had come to see him:
translations.hindi: जाते-जाते श्रीरामचन्द्र जो उन छोटे-बड़े ग्रामों के निवासियों को बातचीत सुनते जाते थे। वे कहते थे कि कामवशबर्ती महा- राज दशरथ को धिक्कार है

verses.sloka: अनुक्रोशो दया चैव यथार्हम् मयि वह् कृतः ।चिरम् दुःखस्य पापीयो गम्यतामर्थसिद्धये ॥२-५०-५॥
verses.transliteration: anukrośo dayā caiva yathārham mayi vah kṛtaḥ ।ciram duḥkhasya pāpīyo gamyatāmarthasiddhaye ॥2-50-5॥

translations.english: You have aptly shown your kindness and compassion to me. It is not proper to prolong one's grief. So do go and altend to your duties.
translations.hindi: हाय पापिनी केकेयी का स्वभाव कैसा कड़वा है और उसका व्यवहार कैला कूर है कि उसने मयौदा को तोड़, ऐसा बुरा काम | कर ही डाला

verses.sloka: तेऽभिवाद्य महात्मानम् कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम् ।विलपन्तो नरा घोरम् व्यतिष्ठन्त क्वचित् क्वचित् ॥२-५०-६॥
verses.transliteration: te'bhivādya mahātmānam kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam ।vilapanto narā ghoram vyatiṣṭhanta kvacit kvacit ॥2-50-6॥

translations.english: All of them paid their homage by circumambulating the highsouled Rama. Crying bitterly, they stood here and there.
translations.hindi: । उसने ऐसे धार्मिक राजपुत्र को वनवास दिया है, जो महा-. विद्वान्‌ , दयालु और जितेन्द्रिय है !

verses.sloka: तथा विलपताम् तेषामतृप्तानाम् च राघवः ।अचक्षुरिषयम् प्रायाद्यथार्कः क्षणदामुखे ॥२-५०-७॥
verses.transliteration: tathā vilapatām teṣāmatṛptānām ca rāghavaḥ ।acakṣuriṣayam prāyādyathārkaḥ kṣaṇadāmukhe ॥2-50-7॥

translations.english: Not yet satisfied (they wanted to linger longer), they stood weeping, while Rama went out of sight just as the Sun disappears at nightfall.
translations.hindi: जनक्रनन्दिनो संहाभागा सीता, जो घर में सदा सुख ही सुख ` में रही है, किस प्रकार वन के कष्ट सह सकेगी

verses.sloka: ततो धान्यधनोपेतान् दानशीलजनान् शिवान् ।अकुतश्चिद्भयान् रम्याम् श्चैत्ययूपसमावृतान् ॥२-५०-८॥
verses.transliteration: tato dhānyadhanopetān dānaśīlajanān śivān ।akutaścidbhayān ramyām ścaityayūpasamāvṛtān ॥2-50-8॥

translations.english: Rama, the best of men, crossed the auspicious land of Kosala which was worth seeing by kings. It looked charming with sacrificial posts and altars, pleasure gardens and mango groves and tanks filled with water. It was rich with herds of cattle, wealth and foodgrains. It was inhabited by charitable, contented and wellnourished people free from fear from any quarter. And it reverberated with the sounds of Vedic recitations.

verses.sloka: उद्यानाम्रवनोपेतान् सम्पन्नसलिलाशयान् ।तुष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णान् गोकुलाकुलसेवितान् ॥२-५०-९॥
verses.transliteration: udyānāmravanopetān sampannasalilāśayān ।tuṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇān gokulākulasevitān ॥2-50-9॥

translations.english: Rama, the best of men, crossed the auspicious land of Kosala which was worth seeing by kings. It looked charming with sacrificial posts and altars, pleasure gardens and mango groves and tanks filled with water. It was rich with herds of cattle, wealth and foodgrains. It was inhabited by charitable, contented and wellnourished people free from fear from any quarter. And it reverberated with the sounds of Vedic recitations.

verses.sloka: लक्षणीयान्न रेम्द्राणाम् ब्रह्मघोषाभिनादितान् ।रथेन पुरुषव्याघ्रः कोसलानत्यवर्तत ॥२-५०-१०॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣaṇīyānna remdrāṇām brahmaghoṣābhināditān ।rathena puruṣavyāghraḥ kosalānatyavartata ॥2-50-10॥

translations.english: Rama, the best of men, crossed the auspicious land of Kosala which was worth seeing by kings. It looked charming with sacrificial posts and altars, pleasure gardens and mango groves and tanks filled with water. It was rich with herds of cattle, wealth and foodgrains. It was inhabited by charitable, contented and wellnourished people free from fear from any quarter. And it reverberated with the sounds of Vedic recitations.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर वे वेदश्रति नामक निर्मल जल से भरी हुई नदी के. पार हों, दक्षिण दिशा की ओर चले

verses.sloka: मध्येन मुदितम् स्फीतम् रम्योद्यानसमाकुलम् ।राज्यम् भोग्यम् नरेन्द्राणाम् ययौ धृतिमताम् वरः ॥२-५०-११॥
verses.transliteration: madhyena muditam sphītam ramyodyānasamākulam ।rājyam bhogyam narendrāṇām yayau dhṛtimatām varaḥ ॥2-50-11॥

translations.english: Rama, the greatest among those endowed with fortitude, travelled through the middle of the kingdom which was pleasing, prosperous and full of ravishing gardens fit to be enjoyed by kings.
translations.hindi: प्रजानामनघं--श्रधनिवर्तकम्‌। (शि) २ ्रगस्त्याध्युषितांदिश-¬ : दक्षिणांदिशं । ( गो० ) ३ गोयुतानूयां -गोयुक्तच्छप्रदेशां । (गो० ). । है. _ घूमा-फि 222 अयोध्याकाण फिर बहुत देर तक मागे चल, शीतल जल बाली और सागर- 'गामिनी गोमती नदी के तट पर पहुँचे । उस समय उसके कछार में $ बहुत सी गौएँ चर रही थीं

verses.sloka: तत्र त्रिपथगाम् दिव्याम् शिव तोयाम् अशैवलाम् ।ददर्श राघवो गन्गाम् पुण्याम् ऋषि निसेविताम् ॥२-५०-१२॥
verses.transliteration: tatra tripathagām divyām śiva toyām aśaivalām ।dadarśa rāghavo gangām puṇyām ṛṣi nisevitām ॥2-50-12॥

translations.english: There Rama saw the holy Ganga flowing in three (worlds) with her sacred waters, free from moss, and worshipped by sages.
translations.hindi: शीघ्र चलने वाले घोड़ों से खींचे जाने वाले रथ पर बैठै हुए श्रीरामचन्द्र जी, गोमती को पार कर स्यन्दका नास नदी के, जिसके किनारों पर मयूर और हंस बोल रहे थे, पार उतरे

verses.sloka: आश्रमैरविदूर्स्थैः श्रीमद्भिः समलम् कृताम् ।कालेऽप्सरोभिर्हृष्टाभिः सेविताम्भोह्रदाम् शिवाम् ॥२-५०-१३॥
verses.transliteration: āśramairavidūrsthaiḥ śrīmadbhiḥ samalam kṛtām ।kāle'psarobhirhṛṣṭābhiḥ sevitāmbhohradām śivām ॥2-50-13॥

translations.english: The holy Ganga, adorned with graceful hermitages situated not far away is visited at times by delightful nymphs who sport in her lakes.
translations.hindi: बह भूमि, जिसे राजा मनु ने पहले इध्ष्राकु को दिया था ओर जो बहुत बिस्तृत थी तथा जिस पर अनेक राष्ट्र बसे हुए थे, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने सीता को दिखलाई

verses.sloka: देवदानवगन्धर्वैः किन्नरैरुपशोभिताम् ।नागगन्धर्वपत्नीभिः सेविताम् सततम् शिवाम् ॥२-५०-१४॥
verses.transliteration: devadānavagandharvaiḥ kinnarairupaśobhitām ।nāgagandharvapatnībhiḥ sevitām satatam śivām ॥2-50-14॥

translations.english: The Ganga is graced by devatas, danavas, gandharvas and kinneras. Wives of several gandharvas always visit this auspicious river.
translations.hindi: सूत इत्येव चाभाष्य सारथिं तमभीक्ष्णञ्ञःः - | मत्तह॑सस्वरः श्रीमानुवाच पुरुपर्षभः ॥१४) तदनन्तर सुसंत्र को सम्बोधन कर पुरुषोत्तम श्रीरामचन्द्र जी मत्तहंस जैसी वाणी से बोले

verses.sloka: देवाक्रीडशताकीर्णाम् देवोद्यानशतायुताम् ।देवार्थमाकाशगमाम् विख्याताम् देवपद्मिनीम् ॥२-५०-१५॥
verses.transliteration: devākrīḍaśatākīrṇām devodyānaśatāyutām ।devārthamākāśagamām vikhyātām devapadminīm ॥2-50-15॥

translations.english: Since this river flows through heavens for the gods, it is wellknown as 'Devapadmini' where celestial lotuses grow. The river embraces hundreds of hills serving as sporting places and pleasuregardens for gods.

verses.sloka: जलघाताट्टहासोग्राम् फेननिर्मलहासिनीम् ।क्वचिद्वेणीकृतजलाम् क्वचिदावर्तशोभिताम् ॥२-५०-१६॥
verses.transliteration: jalaghātāṭṭahāsogrām phenanirmalahāsinīm ।kvacidveṇīkṛtajalām kvacidāvartaśobhitām ॥2-50-16॥

translations.english: The sound of dashing waters of the Ganga is like her laughter and the foam like her sparkling smile. Here she flows straight like the braid of a maiden and there in whirlpools.
translations.hindi: इस संसार में यह पुरानी चाल चली आती है. कि राजषि लोग आवश्यकता पड़ने पर बनों में शिकार खेला करते हैं. । सदा- चारी लोगों को भी श्राद्ध आदि करने के लिए धनुषबाण की आवश्यकता होती है

verses.sloka: क्वचित्स्तिमितगम्भीराम् क्वचिद्वेगजलाकुलाम् ।क्वचिद्गम्भीरनिर्घोषाम् क्वचिद्भैरवनिस्वनाम् ॥२-५०-१७॥
verses.transliteration: kvacitstimitagambhīrām kvacidvegajalākulām ।kvacidgambhīranirghoṣām kvacidbhairavanisvanām ॥2-50-17॥

translations.english: Here the Ganga runs deep but quiet, there she looks perturbed due to fastflowing waters, here she flows with a deep groan and there with a dreadful roar.
translations.hindi: यद्यपि बहुत शिकार खेलना मुझे पसंद नहीं, तथापि राजा . लोग इसे अच्छा बतलाते हैं और लोगों की भी प्रवृत्ति इस ओर अधिक है। अतः मैं'इसे बुरा भी नहीं समझता ओर सरयू के तट पर शिकार खेलना चाहता हूँ

verses.sloka: देवसम्घाप्लुतजलाम् निर्मलोत्पलशोभिताम् ।क्वचिदाभोगपुलिनाम् क्वचिन्नर्मलवालुकाम् ॥२-५०-१८॥
verses.transliteration: devasamghāplutajalām nirmalotpalaśobhitām ।kvacidābhogapulinām kvacinnarmalavālukām ॥2-50-18॥

translations.english: Here hosts of celestials take their ablutions and there she shines with lilies of pure blue. Here her banks are curved and there her bed is dotted with patches of white sand.

verses.sloka: हम्स सरस सम्घुष्टाम् चक्र वाक उपकूजिताम् ।सदामदैश्च विहगैरभिसम्नादिताम् तराम् ॥२-५०-१९॥
verses.transliteration: hamsa sarasa samghuṣṭām cakra vāka upakūjitām ।sadāmadaiśca vihagairabhisamnāditām tarām ॥2-50-19॥

translations.english: The river reverberates with the cries of swans, cranes and chakravakas (ruddy goose). It rings intermittently with the chirpings of birds charged with endless pasison.

verses.sloka: क्वचित्तीररुहैर्वृक्षैर्मालाभिरिव शोभिताम् ।क्वचित्फुल्लोत्पलच्छन्नाम् क्वचित्पद्मवनाकुलाम् ॥२-५०-२०॥
verses.transliteration: kvacittīraruhairvṛkṣairmālābhiriva śobhitām ।kvacitphullotpalacchannām kvacitpadmavanākulām ॥2-50-20॥

translations.english: Here on her banks stand trees adorned as though with garlands, and there in her waters abound fullblown lilies and a forest of lotuses.

verses.sloka: क्वचित्कुमुदष्ण्डैश्च कुड्मलैरुपशोभिताम् ।नानापुष्परजोध्वस्ताम् समदामिव च क्वचित् ॥२-५०-२१॥
verses.transliteration: kvacitkumudaṣṇḍaiśca kuḍmalairupaśobhitām ।nānāpuṣparajodhvastām samadāmiva ca kvacit ॥2-50-21॥

translations.english: Here she is decked with hosts of waterlilies and halfblown flowers while elsewhere she looks intoxicated with the pollen fallen from various flowers.

verses.sloka: व्यपेतमलसम्घाताम् मणिनिर्मलदर्शनाम् ।दिशागजैर्वनगजैर्मत्तैश्च वरवारणैः ॥२-५०-२२॥
verses.transliteration: vyapetamalasamghātām maṇinirmaladarśanām ।diśāgajairvanagajairmattaiśca varavāraṇaiḥ ॥2-50-22॥

translations.english: The river, cleansed of heaps of impurities, appears like a transparent gem. The interiors of forests on her banks always resounds with the trumpeting of mighty, intoxicated, wild elephants guarding the quarters, fit to be the vehicles of gods.

verses.sloka: देवोपवाह्यश्च मुहुः सम्नादितवनान्तराम् ।प्रमदामिव यत्ने न भूषिताम् भूषणोत्तमैः ॥२-५०-२३॥
verses.transliteration: devopavāhyaśca muhuḥ samnāditavanāntarām ।pramadāmiva yatne na bhūṣitām bhūṣaṇottamaiḥ ॥2-50-23॥

translations.english: Just like a lady, Ganga is decorated with the best of ornaments her banks are filled with fruits, flowers, tender leaves or shoots and (flowering) shrubs. It is inhabited by birds and brahmins and infested with sisumaras (small whales), crocodiles and serpents.

verses.sloka: फलैः पुष्पैः किसलयैर्वऋताम् गुल्मैद्द्विजैस्तथा ।शिम्शुमरैः च नक्रैः च भुजम्गैः च निषेविताम् ॥२-५०-२४॥
verses.transliteration: phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kisalayairvaṛtām gulmaiddvijaistathā ।śimśumaraiḥ ca nakraiḥ ca bhujamgaiḥ ca niṣevitām ॥2-50-24॥

translations.english: Just like a lady, Ganga is decorated with the best of ornaments her banks are filled with fruits, flowers, tender leaves or shoots and (flowering) shrubs. It is inhabited by birds and brahmins and infested with sisumaras (small whales), crocodiles and serpents.

verses.sloka: विष्णुपादच्युताम् दिव्यामपापाम् पापनाशिनीम् ।ताम् शङ्करजटाजूटाद्भ्रष्टाम् सागरतेजसा ॥२-५०-२५॥
verses.transliteration: viṣṇupādacyutām divyāmapāpām pāpanāśinīm ।tām śaṅkarajaṭājūṭādbhraṣṭām sāgaratejasā ॥2-50-25॥

translations.english: Mightyarmed Rama reached Srngaberapura on the bank of this consort of the ocean, this Ganga loud with the cries of kraunchas and herons. This sinless, divine Ganga, destroyer of sins who flows from the feet of lord Visnu and by the effulgence (penance) of Sagara's son (Bhagiratha) emerged from the matted locks of lord Siva.

verses.sloka: समुद्रमहीषीम् गङ्गाम् सारसक्रौञ्चनादिताम् ।आससाद महाबाहुः शृङ्गिबेरपुरम् प्रति ॥२-५०-२६॥
verses.transliteration: samudramahīṣīm gaṅgām sārasakrauñcanāditām ।āsasāda mahābāhuḥ śṛṅgiberapuram prati ॥2-50-26॥

translations.english: Mightyarmed Rama reached Srngaberapura on the bank of this consort of the ocean, this Ganga loud with the cries of kraunchas and herons. This sinless, divine Ganga, destroyer of sins who flows from the feet of lord Visnu and by the effulgence (penance) of Sagara's son (Bhagiratha) emerged from the matted locks of lord Siva.

verses.sloka: ताम् ऊर्मि कलिल आवर्ताम् अन्ववेक्ष्य महा रथः ।सुमन्त्रम् अब्रवीत् सूतम् इह एव अद्य वसामहे ॥२-५०-२७॥
verses.transliteration: tām ūrmi kalila āvartām anvavekṣya mahā rathaḥ ।sumantram abravīt sūtam iha eva adya vasāmahe ॥2-50-27॥

translations.english: Beholding river Ganga full of waves and whirlpools, the great chariotwarrior (Rama) said to Sumantra: We shall spend the night here.

verses.sloka: अविदूरात् अयम् नद्या बहु पुष्प प्रवालवान् ।सुमहान् इन्गुदी वृक्षो वसामः अत्र एव सारथे ॥२-५०-२८॥
verses.transliteration: avidūrāt ayam nadyā bahu puṣpa pravālavān ।sumahān ingudī vṛkṣo vasāmaḥ atra eva sārathe ॥2-50-28॥

translations.english: "Not far from the river, charioteer, is this very great ingudi tree rich in flowers and shoots. Let us lodge here."

verses.sloka: द्रक्ष्यामः सरिताम् श्रेष्ठाम् सम्मान्यसलिलाम् शिवाम् ।देवदानवगन्धर्वमृगमानुषपक्षिणाम् ॥२-५०-२९॥
verses.transliteration: drakṣyāmaḥ saritām śreṣṭhām sammānyasalilām śivām ।devadānavagandharvamṛgamānuṣapakṣiṇām ॥2-50-29॥

translations.english: "Let me behold the best of rivers, auspicious, whose waters are honoured by gods and men and gandharvas, by beasts and serpents and birds."

verses.sloka: लक्षणः च सुमन्त्रः च बाढम् इति एव राघवम् ।उक्त्वा तम् इन्गुदी वृक्षम् तदा उपययतुर् हयैः ॥२-५०-३०॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣaṇaḥ ca sumantraḥ ca bāḍham iti eva rāghavam ।uktvā tam ingudī vṛkṣam tadā upayayatur hayaiḥ ॥2-50-30॥

translations.english: Lakshmana and Sumantra said to Raghava, "So be it," and then drove up with the horses to that ingudi tree.

verses.sloka: रामः अभियाय तम् रम्यम् वृक्षम् इक्ष्वाकु नन्दनः ।रथात् अवातरत् तस्मात् सभार्यः सह लक्ष्मणः ॥२-५०-३१॥
verses.transliteration: rāmaḥ abhiyāya tam ramyam vṛkṣam ikṣvāku nandanaḥ ।rathāt avātarat tasmāt sabhāryaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ॥2-50-31॥

translations.english: Rama, the delight of the Ikshvakus, came to that lovely tree and descended from the chariot with his wife and with Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: सुमन्त्रः अपि अवतीर्य एव मोचयित्वा हय उत्तमान् ।वृक्ष मूल गतम् रामम् उपतस्थे कृत अन्जलिः ॥२-५०-३२॥
verses.transliteration: sumantraḥ api avatīrya eva mocayitvā haya uttamān ।vṛkṣa mūla gatam rāmam upatasthe kṛta anjaliḥ ॥2-50-32॥

translations.english: Sumantra too descended, unyoked the excellent horses, and waited with joined palms upon Rama, who was seated at the foot of the tree.

verses.sloka: तत्र राजा गुहो नाम रामस्य आत्म समः सखा ।निषाद जात्यो बलवान् स्थपतिः च इति विश्रुतः ॥२-५०-३३॥
verses.transliteration: tatra rājā guho nāma rāmasya ātma samaḥ sakhā ।niṣāda jātyo balavān sthapatiḥ ca iti viśrutaḥ ॥2-50-33॥

translations.english: There was a king there named Guha, a friend to Rama as his own self, mighty, of the Nishada race, and renowned as a chief.

verses.sloka: स श्रुत्वा पुरुष व्याघ्रम् रामम् विषयम् आगतम् ।वृद्धैः परिवृतः अमात्यैः ज्ञातिभिः च अपि उपागतः ॥२-५०-३४॥
verses.transliteration: sa śrutvā puruṣa vyāghram rāmam viṣayam āgatam ।vṛddhaiḥ parivṛtaḥ amātyaiḥ jñātibhiḥ ca api upāgataḥ ॥2-50-34॥

translations.english: Hearing that Rama, the tiger among men, had come to his realm, he came attended by the elders, by his ministers and by his kinsmen.

verses.sloka: ततः निषाद अधिपतिम् दृष्ट्वा दूरात् अवस्थितम् ।सह सौमित्रिणा रामः समागच्चद् गुहेन सः ॥२-५०-३५॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ niṣāda adhipatim dṛṣṭvā dūrāt avasthitam ।saha saumitriṇā rāmaḥ samāgaccad guhena saḥ ॥2-50-35॥

translations.english: Then, seeing the lord of the Nishadas approaching from afar, Rama went with Saumitri to meet Guha.

verses.sloka: तम् आर्तः सम्परिष्वज्य गुहो राघवम् अब्रवीत् ।यथा अयोध्या तथा इदम् ते राम किम् करवाणि ते ॥२-५०-३६॥
verses.transliteration: tam ārtaḥ sampariṣvajya guho rāghavam abravīt ।yathā ayodhyā tathā idam te rāma kim karavāṇi te ॥2-50-36॥

translations.english: Stricken, Guha embraced him and said to Raghava: "As Ayodhya is, so is this yours, Rama. What shall I do for you?"

verses.sloka: ईदृशम् हि महाबाहो कः प्रप्स्यत्यतिथिम् प्रियम् ।ततः गुणवद् अन्न अद्यम् उपादाय पृथग् विधम् ।अर्घ्यम् च उपानयत् क्षिप्रम् वाक्यम् च इदम् उवाच ह ॥२-५०-३७॥
verses.transliteration: īdṛśam hi mahābāho kaḥ prapsyatyatithim priyam ।tataḥ guṇavad anna adyam upādāya pṛthag vidham ।arghyam ca upānayat kṣipram vākyam ca idam uvāca ha ॥2-50-37॥

translations.english: "Who indeed shall obtain so beloved a guest, mighty-armed one?" Then, taking up excellent food and provision of many kinds,

verses.sloka: स्वागतम् ते महा बाहो तव इयम् अखिला मही ।वयम् प्रेष्या भवान् भर्ता साधु राज्यम् प्रशाधि नः ॥२-५०-३८॥
verses.transliteration: svāgatam te mahā bāho tava iyam akhilā mahī ।vayam preṣyā bhavān bhartā sādhu rājyam praśādhi naḥ ॥2-50-38॥

translations.english: he swiftly presented the guest-offering and spoke these words: "Welcome to you, mighty-armed one. This whole earth is yours."

verses.sloka: भक्ष्यम् भोज्यम् च पेयम् च लेह्यम् च इदम् उपस्थितम् ।शयनानि च मुख्यानि वाजिनाम् खादनम् च ते ॥२-५०-३९॥
verses.transliteration: bhakṣyam bhojyam ca peyam ca lehyam ca idam upasthitam ।śayanāni ca mukhyāni vājinām khādanam ca te ॥2-50-39॥

translations.english: "We are your servants and your honour is our lord; rule our kingdom well. Food to chew and to eat, to drink and to lick, is ready, and choice couches for you, and fodder for the horses."

verses.sloka: गुहम् एव ब्रुवाणम् तम् राघवः प्रत्युवाच ह ॥२-५०-४०॥
verses.transliteration: guham eva bruvāṇam tam rāghavaḥ pratyuvāca ha ॥2-50-40॥

translations.english: As he spoke thus, Raghava replied to Guha: "By you we have at all times been honoured and gladdened,

verses.sloka: अर्चिताः चैव हृष्टाः च भवता सर्वथा वयम् ।पद्भ्याम् अभिगमाच् चैव स्नेह सम्दर्शनेन च ॥२-५०-४१॥
verses.transliteration: arcitāḥ caiva hṛṣṭāḥ ca bhavatā sarvathā vayam ।padbhyām abhigamāc caiva sneha samdarśanena ca ॥2-50-41॥

translations.english: "by your coming on foot and by this show of affection." And pressing him with his two well-rounded arms, he spoke these words:

verses.sloka: भुजाभ्याम् साधु वृत्ताभ्याम् पीडयन् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ।दिष्ट्या त्वाम् गुह पश्यामिअरोगम् सह बान्धवैः ॥२-५०-४२॥
verses.transliteration: bhujābhyām sādhu vṛttābhyām pīḍayan vākyam abravīt ।diṣṭyā tvām guha paśyāmiarogam saha bāndhavaiḥ ॥2-50-42॥

translations.english: "By good fortune, Guha, I see you in health along with your kinsmen. Is all well too in your realm, among your friends and in your woods?"

verses.sloka: अपि ते कूशलम् राष्ट्रे मित्रेषु च धनेषु च ।यत् तु इदम् भवता किम्चित् प्रीत्या समुपकल्पितम् ।सर्वम् तत् अनुजानामि न हि वर्ते प्रतिग्रहे ॥२-५०-४३॥
verses.transliteration: api te kūśalam rāṣṭre mitreṣu ca dhaneṣu ca ।yat tu idam bhavatā kimcit prītyā samupakalpitam ।sarvam tat anujānāmi na hi varte pratigrahe ॥2-50-43॥

translations.english: "Whatever little you have made ready out of affection, I acknowledge it all; but I do not engage in the accepting of gifts."

verses.sloka: कुश चीर अजिन धरम् फल मूल अशनम् च माम् ।विद्धि प्रणिहितम् धर्मे तापसम् वन गोचरम् ॥२-५०-४४॥
verses.transliteration: kuśa cīra ajina dharam phala mūla aśanam ca mām ।viddhi praṇihitam dharme tāpasam vana gocaram ॥2-50-44॥

translations.english: "Know me for an ascetic ranging the forest, wearing kusha and bark and deerskin, living on fruit and root, and set upon dharma."

verses.sloka: अश्वानाम् खादनेन अहम् अर्थी न अन्येन केनचित् ।एतावता अत्र भवता भविष्यामि सुपूजितः ॥२-५०-४५॥
verses.transliteration: aśvānām khādanena aham arthī na anyena kenacit ।etāvatā atra bhavatā bhaviṣyāmi supūjitaḥ ॥2-50-45॥

translations.english: "I have need of fodder for the horses and of nothing else at all; by this much alone shall I be well honoured by you."

verses.sloka: एते हि दयिता राज्ञः पितुर् दशरथस्य मे ।एतैः सुविहितैः अश्वैः भविष्याम्य् अहम् अर्चितः ॥२-५०-४६॥
verses.transliteration: ete hi dayitā rājñaḥ pitur daśarathasya me ।etaiḥ suvihitaiḥ aśvaiḥ bhaviṣyāmy aham arcitaḥ ॥2-50-46॥

translations.english: "These horses were dear to my father, king Dasaratha; if they are well tended, I shall be honoured by them."

verses.sloka: अश्वानाम् प्रतिपानम् च खादनम् चैव सो अन्वशात् ।गुहः तत्र एव पुरुषाम्स् त्वरितम् दीयताम् इति ॥२-५०-४७॥
verses.transliteration: aśvānām pratipānam ca khādanam caiva so anvaśāt ।guhaḥ tatra eva puruṣāms tvaritam dīyatām iti ॥2-50-47॥

translations.english: Guha there and then commanded his men that drink and fodder for the horses be given swiftly.

verses.sloka: ततः चीर उत्तर आसन्गः सम्ध्याम् अन्वास्य पश्चिमाम् ।जलम् एव आददे भोज्यम् लक्ष्मणेन आहृतम् स्वयम् ॥२-५०-४८॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ cīra uttara āsangaḥ samdhyām anvāsya paścimām ।jalam eva ādade bhojyam lakṣmaṇena āhṛtam svayam ॥2-50-48॥

translations.english: Then, with bark for his upper garment, he performed the evening twilight rite and took water alone for his food, fetched by Lakshmana himself.

verses.sloka: तस्य भूमौ शयानस्य पादौ प्रक्षाल्य लक्ष्मणः ।सभार्यस्य ततः अभ्येत्य तस्थौ वृष्कम् उपाश्रितः ॥२-५०-४९॥
verses.transliteration: tasya bhūmau śayānasya pādau prakṣālya lakṣmaṇaḥ ।sabhāryasya tataḥ abhyetya tasthau vṛṣkam upāśritaḥ ॥2-50-49॥

translations.english: Then Lakshmana washed the feet of Rama and his wife as they lay upon the ground, and withdrawing, stood leaning against a tree.

verses.sloka: गुहो अपि सह सूतेन सौमित्रिम् अनुभाषयन् ।अन्वजाग्रत् ततः रामम् अप्रमत्तः धनुर् धरः ॥२-५०-५०॥
verses.transliteration: guho api saha sūtena saumitrim anubhāṣayan ।anvajāgrat tataḥ rāmam apramattaḥ dhanur dharaḥ ॥2-50-50॥

translations.english: Guha too, conversing with the charioteer and with Saumitri, kept vigilant watch over Rama, bow in hand.

verses.sloka: तथा शयानस्य ततः अस्य धीमतः ।यशस्विनो दाशरथेर् महात्मनः ।अदृष्ट दुह्खस्य सुख उचितस्य सा ।तदा व्यतीयाय चिरेण शर्वरी ॥२-५०-५१॥
verses.transliteration: tathā śayānasya tataḥ asya dhīmataḥ ।yaśasvino dāśarather mahātmanaḥ ।adṛṣṭa duhkhasya sukha ucitasya sā ।tadā vyatīyāya cireṇa śarvarī ॥2-50-51॥

translations.english: So, as that illustrious, high-minded and great-souled son of Dasaratha lay there, he who had never known sorrow and was accustomed to ease, the night passed very slowly.
